steps.name: read-cluster-config
pull-and-build
steps.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -euo pipefail
proxy=$(cat /workspace/proxy/http-proxy)
export HTTP_PROXY="$proxy" HTTPS_PROXY="$proxy"
export http_proxy="$proxy" https_proxy="$proxy"
export NO_PROXY= no_proxy= ALL_PROXY= all_proxy=
image=registry.access.redhat.com/ubi10/openjdk-25-runtime:1784364635
negative_root=/workspace/build/negative/root
negative_runroot=/workspace/build/negative/runroot
positive_root=/workspace/build/positive/root
positive_runroot=/workspace/build/positive/runroot
mkdir -p "$negative_root" "$negative_runroot" "$positive_root" "$positive_runroot" /workspace/build/context
negative_log=/workspace/build/negative-pull.log
set +e
buildah --storage-driver=vfs --root "$negative_root" --runroot "$negative_runroot" \
  pull --tls-verify=true "docker://$image" >"$negative_log" 2>&1
negative_status=$?
set -e
if [[ $negative_status -eq 0 ]]; then
  echo 'pull without the mounted proxy CA unexpectedly succeeded' >&2
  exit 1
fi
if ! grep -Fqi 'x509: certificate signed by unknown authority' "$negative_log"; then
  echo 'negative pull failed for a reason other than missing proxy CA trust' >&2
  cat "$negative_log" >&2
  exit 1
fi
echo NEGATIVE_CA_CONTROL_PASSED
test -s /mnt/proxy-ca-bundle/ca-bundle.crt
cp /mnt/proxy-ca-bundle/ca-bundle.crt /etc/pki/ca-trust/source/anchors/caching-ca-bundle.crt
update-ca-trust
buildah --storage-driver=vfs --root "$positive_root" --runroot "$positive_runroot" \
  pull --tls-verify=true "docker://$image"
printf 'FROM %s\nLABEL konflux.proxy-regression=KFLUXVNGD-1358\n' "$image" \
  > /workspace/build/context/Containerfile
buildah --storage-driver=vfs --root "$positive_root" --runroot "$positive_runroot" \
  bud --isolation=chroot --pull=never --tls-verify=true \
  -t localhost/proxy-regression:1358 /workspace/build/context
echo IMAGE_PULL_AND_BUILD_SUCCESS
